bound.walk: copy printed feed.entries id and path from the official /service catalog; join each path to the catalog origin with the same q=*&format=json query the catalog uses to print members
bound.how: pda ingest --source npolar --limit 10. The official Norsk Polarinstitutt /service list prints service paths. The adapter copies those printed ids and paths. A bare collection path prints only a count object, so access_path keeps the catalog query. The live catalog printed 5 services so ingest stored 5.
